title: 戦略会計入門
subtitle: Management Accounting Basic
teachers:
MASUBUCHI Takashi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Accounting Basic Ability” learning/education goal of the Department of Management Information. It aims to cultivate in the students various skills related to the creation of profit plans and cash plans, using exercises relating accounting information and the financial management of companies from a profit management and money management perspective.
advice:
This course consists of three parts:
In the first part, students will learn about variable income statements, CVP analysis, and profit charts.
In the second part, students will learn to create profit plans, focusing on relevant exercises.
In the third part, we will cover topics from profit planning to financial planning, focusing on exercises.

Since there are numbers of exercises to prepare, it is important that students take an active approach to the class.
requiredKnowledge:
Students should review the contents of Basic Accounting, a course that must be taken prior to this course.
It is also important for students to understand that the contents learned in this course will be needed for　"Strategic Accounting Application".

activityGoals.body: Be able to create a variable income statement and perform a CVP analysis.
Be able to create a profit plan master plan following the profit plan creation procedure.
Be able to create an estimated income statement.
Be able to understand the importance of cash flow management.
Be able to create an estimated balance sheet / estimated cash flow statement.

achievementLevels.ideal:
・Understand the significance of CVP analysis and how to use profit charts and conduct simulations using CVP sensitivity analysis.
・Be able to systematically calculate required profit and prepare a budget using the proper procedure.
・Be able to create an estimated balance sheet / estimated cash flow statement using the proper procedure for creating a financial plan.
・Understand the importance of cash flow management.
・Understand how to obtain working capital and understand the importance of cash flow.
achievementLevels.standard:
・Understand the significance of CVP analysis and how to use profit charts and conduct simulations through CVP sensitivity analysis.
・Be able to systematically calculate required profit and prepare a budget using the proper procedure.
・Be able to create an estimated balance sheet / estimated cash flow statement using the proper procedure for creating a financial plan.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course consists of three parts:
In the first part, students will learn about variable income statements, CVP analysis, and profit charts.
In the second part, students will learn to create profit plans, focusing on relevant exercises.
In the third part, we will cover topics from profit planning to financial planning, focusing on exercises.

Since there are numbers of exercises to prepare, it is important that students take an active approach to the class.
